// Package sample is a fixture for goanalysis tests.
package sample

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/sample/sub"
)

// Server serves things.
type Server struct {
	// Addr is the listen address.
	Addr string
	// Store backs the server.
	Store sub.Store
	count int
}

// NewServer builds a Server.
func NewServer(addr string) *Server {
	return &Server{Addr: addr, Store: sub.NewMemStore()}
}

// Start starts the server.
func (s *Server) Start() error {
	s.count++
	return s.Store.Put(fmt.Sprintf("started:%s", s.Addr))
}

func (s *Server) reset() { s.count = 0 }

// Handler handles a request.
type Handler interface {
	Handle(req string) error
	internal()
}

const (
	// DefaultAddr is the default listen address.
	DefaultAddr = ":8080"
	secret      = "x"
)

var version = "1.0"
